Prototype 4 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EOG (78%), with EEG (14%) and EMG (9%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+1.0 dB, sensitivity=11.5) and elevated σ_h (+1.2 dB, sensitivity=6.8).
The δ activity is present in 24% of each epoch (transient), with active eye movements (REM 41% active) and atonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with REM physiology: EOG dominant, EMG atonic, θ elevated — all confirmed. Note: model primarily uses δ, atypical for REM.
